standards.summaryText: Careful observation of form and surface qualities is necessary for the realistic recording of natural objects.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Careful observation of form and surface qualities is necessary for the realistic recording of natural objects.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to careful observation of form and surface qualities is necessary for the realistic recording of natural objects.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Drawings > Outcome 1: Record > Concept 1.A

standards.summaryText: Concepts of positive and negative space can be employed when drawing people in groups.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Concepts of positive and negative space can be employed when drawing people in groups.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to concepts of positive and negative space can be employed when drawing people in groups.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Drawings > Outcome 1: Record > Concept 1.B

standards.summaryText: The illusion of depth is created partly by the kinds of lines and marks used in creating an image.
standards.officialOutcomeText: The illusion of depth is created partly by the kinds of lines and marks used in creating an image.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to the illusion of depth is created partly by the kinds of lines and marks used in creating an image.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Drawings > Outcome 1: Record > Concept 1.C

standards.summaryText: A consideration of balance and contrast may be applied to drawings that depict forms in nature.
standards.officialOutcomeText: A consideration of balance and contrast may be applied to drawings that depict forms in nature.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to a consideration of balance and contrast may be applied to drawings that depict forms in nature.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Drawings > Outcome 2: Investigate > Concept 2.A

standards.summaryText: Repetition of shape in nature can suggest patterns and motifs.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Repetition of shape in nature can suggest patterns and motifs.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to repetition of shape in nature can suggest patterns and motifs.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Drawings > Outcome 2: Investigate > Concept 2.B

standards.summaryText: A changing point of view can allow a more thorough analysis of the subject matter of drawing.
standards.officialOutcomeText: A changing point of view can allow a more thorough analysis of the subject matter of drawing.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to a changing point of view can allow a more thorough analysis of the subject matter of drawing.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Drawings > Outcome 2: Investigate > Concept 2.C

standards.summaryText: The subjective perception of the individual student affects the way he/she expresses action and direction.
standards.officialOutcomeText: The subjective perception of the individual student affects the way he/she expresses action and direction.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to the subjective perception of the individual student affects the way he/she expresses action and direction.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Drawings > Outcome 3: Communicate > Concept 3.A

standards.summaryText: Mood and feeling as perceived by the individual student can be expressed in colour drawings.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Mood and feeling as perceived by the individual student can be expressed in colour drawings.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to mood and feeling as perceived by the individual student can be expressed in colour drawings.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Drawings > Outcome 3: Communicate > Concept 3.B

standards.summaryText: Exaggeration of mood characteristics in drawings of nature and people can help to emphasize a personal point of view.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Exaggeration of mood characteristics in drawings of nature and people can help to emphasize a personal point of view.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to exaggeration of mood characteristics in drawings of nature and people can help to emphasize a personal point of view.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Drawings > Outcome 3: Communicate > Concept 3.C

standards.summaryText: Making comparisons about mood and feeling between one’s own works and works by other students is part of learning to talk about art.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Making comparisons about mood and feeling between one’s own works and works by other students is part of learning to talk about art.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to making comparisons about mood and feeling between one’s own works and works by other students is part of learning to talk about art.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Drawings > Outcome 4: Articulate and Evaluate > Concept 4.A

standards.summaryText: Knowing the terms of design, media and techniques used in one’s own drawings helps in description and analysis of one’s own and others’ works.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Knowing the terms of design, media and techniques used in one’s own drawings helps in description and analysis of one’s own and others’ works.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to knowing the terms of design, media and techniques used in one’s own drawings helps in description and analysis of one’s own and others’ works.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Drawings > Outcome 4: Articulate and Evaluate > Concept 4.B

standards.summaryText: Manipulation of colour emphasis can help express mood in two-dimensional compositions.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Manipulation of colour emphasis can help express mood in two-dimensional compositions.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to manipulation of colour emphasis can help express mood in two-dimensional compositions.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Compositions > Outcome 5: Components 1 > Concept 5.A

standards.summaryText: Organic shapes derived from natural objects can be developed into three-dimensional forms.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Organic shapes derived from natural objects can be developed into three-dimensional forms.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to organic shapes derived from natural objects can be developed into three-dimensional forms.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Compositions > Outcome 5: Components 1 > Concept 5.B

standards.summaryText: The qualities of transparency and opacity suggest relationships of space and form in compositions.
standards.officialOutcomeText: The qualities of transparency and opacity suggest relationships of space and form in compositions.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to the qualities of transparency and opacity suggest relationships of space and form in compositions.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Compositions > Outcome 6: Components 2 > Concept 6.A

standards.summaryText: The qualities of transparency and opacity suggest the presence or absence of light in compositions.
standards.officialOutcomeText: The qualities of transparency and opacity suggest the presence or absence of light in compositions.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to the qualities of transparency and opacity suggest the presence or absence of light in compositions.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Compositions > Outcome 6: Components 2 > Concept 6.B

standards.summaryText: Variation of form: natural objects exhibit wide variation of form within a single type.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Variation of form: natural objects exhibit wide variation of form within a single type.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to variation of form: natural objects exhibit wide variation of form within a single type.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Compositions > Outcome 7: Components 3 > Concept 7.A

standards.summaryText: Control of colour and space: certain colours advance and recede, according to the colours around them.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Control of colour and space: certain colours advance and recede, according to the colours around them.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to control of colour and space: certain colours advance and recede, according to the colours around them.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Compositions > Outcome 7: Components 3 > Concept 7.B

standards.summaryText: Control of space: a sense of distance or close proximity can be conveyed through the amount of detail used in compositions (micro–macro images).
standards.officialOutcomeText: Control of space: a sense of distance or close proximity can be conveyed through the amount of detail used in compositions (micro–macro images).
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to control of space: a sense of distance or close proximity can be conveyed through the amount of detail used in compositions (micro–macro images).
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Compositions > Outcome 7: Components 3 > Concept 7.C

standards.summaryText: Cluster and concentration of design elements in compositions tend to suggest compression and/or movement.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Cluster and concentration of design elements in compositions tend to suggest compression and/or movement.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to cluster and concentration of design elements in compositions tend to suggest compression or movement.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Compositions > Outcome 8: Relationships 1 > Concept 8.A

standards.summaryText: Differences in size or value of design elements in compositions suggest dominance and emphasis of larger, stronger elements.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Differences in size or value of design elements in compositions suggest dominance and emphasis of larger, stronger elements.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to differences in size or value of design elements in compositions suggest dominance and emphasis of larger, stronger elements.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Compositions > Outcome 8: Relationships 1 > Concept 8.B

standards.summaryText: Making comparisons about pictorial styles between one’s own works and the works of other students is part of learning to talk about art.
standards.officialOutcomeText: Making comparisons about pictorial styles between one’s own works and the works of other students is part of learning to talk about art.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to making comparisons about pictorial styles between one’s own works and the works of other students is part of learning to talk about art.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Compositions > Outcome 9: Relationships 2 > Concept 9.A

standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to knowing the terms for design, media and techniques used in one’s own compositions helps in description and analysis of one’s own and others’ works.

standards.officialOutcomeText: The same composition, when executed with different colour schemes, communicates a different mood or feeling.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to the same composition, when executed with different colour schemes, communicates a different mood or feeling.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Compositions > Outcome 10: Organizations > Concept 10.A

standards.officialOutcomeText: The same forms, when composed with different spatial relationships, present different visual effects.
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to the same forms, when composed with different spatial relationships, present different visual effects.
standards.sourceLocator: FARART_79 > ART9 > Compositions > Outcome 10: Organizations > Concept 10.B

standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop art abilities related to images of individual people change through time and across cultures.
